triage.fix_rationale: Add an ignore rule for typescript major (or semver-major) updates in .github/dependabot.yml until the Angular packages support TS 7. Keep the typescript pin in package.json and package-lock.json consistent with the Angular peer range.
triage.hypothesis: Dependabot tried to bump typescript to 7.0.2, but @angular/build@22.0.5 peers on typescript ">=6.0 <6.1", so npm cannot resolve the tree. The retry with --force then ran ~48 minutes and died with SIGABRT. The failure comes from a peer-dependency conflict in the version bump, not from the project's code.
